veranderings.blok: Jy stem nie self vir 'n President nie
veranderings.voor: Parlement wat die kiesers self kies
veranderings.na: Parlement wat deur die kiesers self gekies word
veranderings.rede: As written, 'wat die kiesers self kies' can also read as the part of Parliament that chooses the voters; the passive leaves only the intended reading.

veranderings.voor: Jy maak jou merk op jou stembriewe in 'n stemhokkie.
veranderings.na: Jy merk jou stembriewe in 'n stemhokkie.
veranderings.rede: One 'merk' on several ballots is a mismatch, and the plain verb says the same thing more directly.
